operating_notes.text: Standalone revenue fell to ₹176.78 Cr in FY26 from ₹241.94 Cr in FY25, while other income rose to ₹160.67 Cr from ₹81.82 Cr.
QIP proceeds of ₹899.99 Cr raised; ₹640.27 Cr utilised to 31 March 2026, ₹258.07 Cr in mutual funds, debentures and bonds.
Composite scheme of amalgamation with appointed date 1 January 2025 awaiting NCLT sanction.
FY26 pre-sales ₹576 Cr on MNRL share and ₹832 Cr including post-merger portfolio; collections ₹781 Cr.
Unsold value on the listed entity about ₹6,500 Cr on MNRL share; unsold launched inventory ₹2,000 Cr with ₹1,600 Cr cost to complete.
Marathon Futurex pre-sales ₹466 Cr, up 15% YoY; commercial rates up 15% over the previous year; more than 300 clients including Nykaa, ZEE, L'Oréal, SBI and HDFC.
Q1FY27 sold 38,000 sq ft with booking value ₹86 Cr and collection ₹118 Cr on MNRL share.
Added ₹900 Cr redevelopment GDV in Versova and Sewri.
Monte South footfalls dramatically increased; ready-to-move inventory supports 100% collection TAT of 3 months.
Q2FY27: Future X commercial project recognised ₹19.26 Cr revenue, of which ₹8.38 Cr (43.50%) was shared with Marathon Realty Private Limited under a 2015 shareholder agreement.
QIP proceeds of ₹899.99 Cr: ₹695.40 Cr utilised to 30 September 2026, ₹203.79 Cr in mutual funds, debentures and bonds, ₹0.81 Cr in bank.
Composite scheme of amalgamation: Company Scheme Petition (second motion) filed with NCLT Mumbai on 24 September 2026.
Q2FY27: existing-portfolio pre-sales ₹154 Cr on 0.71 lakh sq ft; merged portfolio ₹251 Cr on 0.94 lakh sq ft.
Q2FY27: affordable and mid-income pre-sales rose 155% QoQ; Monte South grew 16%.
Q2FY27: two new redevelopment projects in Versova and Sewri with combined estimated GDV of ₹900 crore.
Approved acquiring an additional 60% stake in SRTL for up to ₹335 Cr (₹135 Cr cash + ₹200 Cr bank guarantee) to secure full economic interest in Monte South.
Monte South project represents approximately 25 lakh sq. ft. of area across four 64-storey residential towers and one commercial tower.
Tower A has received full OC; Tower B has OC up to the 45th floor; Tower C RCC complete to 35th floor; Tower D yet to be launched.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹113.55 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹44.7 Cr.

Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited’s Board, led by **Ashok Yogesh** and **Yogesh Patole**, approved a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share (20% on ₹5 face value) for FY2026, pending shareholder approval.

Marathon Nextgen's Q4 & FY26 call (1 June 2026): FY26 pre-sales ₹576 Cr on MNRL share (₹832 Cr incl. post-merger), collections ₹781 Cr, unsold value about ₹6,500 Cr; amalgamation documents filed with NCLT, hearing awaited.

Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 10, 2026, reporting total income of ₹217 Cr, EBITDA of ₹66 Cr, and PAT of ₹52 Cr, and adding ₹900 Cr redevelopment GDV in Versova and Sewri.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹128.95 Cr (+10.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹43.93 Cr.
Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited rescheduled its Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings conference call from October 23, 2026, to October 28, 2026, at 12:30 PM IST, signed by Yogesh Patole.

Marathon Nextgen's Q2FY27 release (22 Oct 2026): existing-portfolio pre-sales ₹154 Cr (+79% QoQ), collections ₹127 Cr, total income ₹145 Cr, PAT ₹45 Cr; added Versova and Sewri redevelopment projects with ₹900 Cr combined GDV.
Earnings Conference Call of Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited, scheduled for 28 Oct 2026 at 12:30 PM IST, postponed.
Marathon Nextgen Realty approved acquiring an additional 60% stake in joint venture Swayam Realtors and Traders LLP for up to ₹335 Cr to gain full economic interest in the Monte South project.
Marathon Nextgen approved acquiring Adani Group's 60% stake in the Monte South project for ₹335 Cr to reach 100% ownership.
